verdict.reasons: The product correctly matches the white-and-blue cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll with the legitimate 'AFP | 09134922013' watermark and readable, unaltered main branding. The installed laterals, neutral seedlings, and soil texture provide coherent technical evidence that supports the agronomic intent. The small, localized loop of tape in the immediate foreground is treated as an advisory detail rather than a core defect because it does not contradict the commercial product family, misidentify the hardware, or obscure the primary illustration goals.

focused_physical_review.reason: An additional black plastic tape is visible to the right of the required AFP package. The tape is not an installed lateral line running along the crop row, but instead forms a distinct, closed loop resting on the soil. While the required white and blue package itself does not have a visible external strip or tail protruding from its cartons, the presence of this separate, uninstalled coiled tape constitutes an extra loose product. The soil gap around the main package is not clear because it is immediately adjacent to this extra loose coiled object on the ground.
